questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some teachers are writers.

All writers are professionals.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some professionals are teachers.

(II) All teachers are professionals.12100
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29e644b0b07ba8de2e772fb036f4b29d4a467afc63225f29b1aa8f6571d24dc9.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some professionals are teachers → Follow (As some teachers are writers and all writers are professionals. As some part of teachers is common with writers which whole comes in professionals, therefore it is true.)

(II) All teachers are professionals → Does not follow (As some teachers are writers and all writers are professionals. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

 A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’,

 A - B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

 A times B means ‘A is the husband of B’ and

 A div B means ‘A is the brother of B’.

Based on the above, how is T related to J if ‘ T + K div S times U - J ’?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is

 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Mother
 Husband
 Brother
 
 

 to B
 
 

Given: T + K ÷ S × U - J = ?

T + K → T is the sister of K.

K ÷ S → K is the brother of S.

S × U → S is the husband of U.

U - J → U is the mother of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53e3b85ff6e664407345d314831409297c1f6fc61d710991558884588485ed8b.png] 

Here, T is J's father's sister.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Roshan ranked 54th from the top and 18th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
According to the question:

Roshan's rank from the top → 54th

Roshan's rank from the bottom → 18th

Total students → Roshan's rank from the top + Roshan's rank from the bottom - 1

→ 54 + 18 - 1 = 71

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘ ÷ ‘ are interchanged and ‘ - ’ and ‘ x ’ are interchanged?

 312 + 6 times 5 - 32 div 300 = ?

According to the question, after ‘+’ and ‘ ÷ ‘ are interchanged and ‘ - ’ and ‘ × ’ are interchanged:

312 + 6 × 5 − 32 ÷ 300 = ? ⇒ 312 ÷ 6 - 5 × 32 + 300 = ?

⇒ __**312 ÷ 6**__ - 5 × 32 + 300 = ?

⇒ 52 - __**5 × 32**__ + 300 = ?

⇒ __**52 + 300**__ - 160 = ?

⇒ __**352 - 160**__ = ?

⇒ 192 = ?

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only two people sit between P and O when counted from the left of O. W sits third to the left of N. Y sits to the immediate right of N. Y sits second to the left of P. X is not an immediate neighbour of W. Who sits third to the right of M?
questions.solution:
Given: M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) Only two people sit between P and O when counted from the left of O.

2) Y sits second to the left of P.

3) Y sits to the immediate right of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4081a8899cac11bee6ff8d5651b6a0146be7266eb19c9252dd63bf9122052b4c.png] 

4) W sits third to the left of N.

5) X is not an immediate neighbour of W. 

The remaining position will be occupied by the only person left i.e. M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddcedafb92415b115d7348fd11770c38cc4c4d7e3fffd74d59e76518c4124809.png] 

Thus, Y sits third to the right of M.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
